terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the SAVICO AI platform. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By accessing or using the platform you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 2. Use of the service
sections.body: The AI-generated drawings and cost estimates are for reference only; actual results and costs may vary. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide.

sections.title: 3. Accounts
sections.body: You must provide accurate registration details and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account.

sections.title: 4. Intellectual property
sections.body: Content, branding and materials on the platform belong to SAVICO unless stated otherwise.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of liability
sections.body: Estimates are indicative. SAVICO is not liable for decisions made solely based on AI-generated outputs.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.body: For questions about these terms, please contact us via the channels listed on the contact section.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.updated: Last updated: placeholder — final copy provided by SAVICO before go-live.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data in accordance with Vietnam's Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
sections.body: Account details (name, email, phone), floor-plan images you upload for AI processing, and contact/lead form submissions. We do not collect land-title (deed) documents.

sections.title: 2. How we use data
sections.body: To provide the design and estimate services, respond to your requests, and improve the platform.

sections.title: 3. Image data
sections.body: Uploaded floor-plan images are used only to generate drawings and renders. They are stored securely and can be deleted on request.

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data. AI processing may involve trusted providers under confidentiality obligations.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.body: For privacy requests, please contact us via the channels listed on the contact section.

advisory.intro: Hi {name}, based on what you shared — {building} at {address}, with an AI-estimated floor area of about {area} m² — SAVICO AI has prepared a preliminary estimate totalling {total}.

dominant.structure: Structure carries the largest share — common for taller builds or soft ground that needs reinforced foundations. To optimise, review the structural option and floor count before you commit.
dominant.finishing: Finishing carries the largest share — this is the part most sensitive to material choices. Switching to same-tier tiles, stone and fixtures from another brand can cut the figure noticeably without hurting the look.
dominant.interior: Interior carries the largest share — you can split it in two phases: built-in joinery first, loose furniture added after you move in.

advisory.style: The {style} style you chose matches the layouts in the Handbook — open the Handbook to browse samples in the same style and save the ones you like.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. SAVICO helps you find and connect with vetted contractors free of charge.
faq.q2: What do I need to start?
faq.a2: Just basic details about the build and what you need done. You can create a brief for free without buying a package.
faq.q3: How many contractors can I invite?
faq.a3: Up to 3 per project. The cap keeps every survey trackable instead of flooding you with calls.
faq.q4: Can I see quotes on the website?
faq.a4: No. After the survey the contractor sends the quote to you directly; SAVICO neither stores nor displays any amounts.
faq.q5: Does SAVICO do the building work?
faq.a5: No. SAVICO is a neutral connection platform — we neither build nor sell materials.

pricing.title: SAVICO construction supervision
pricing.subtitle: Engineer checks at key milestones, paired with digital tracking on SAVICO
pricing.selfChosen: Noted. Your project stays self-managed — you can upgrade at any time.
pricing.costNote: Supervision typically costs 0.6–1.3% of the build value. On a 1.5 billion VND build, CHECK is about 0.6% and CONTROL about 1.3%.

scope.title: What the service covers
scope.r1: SAVICO inspects, records, flags, reports and follows up within the plan you choose.
scope.r2: The contractor remains responsible for the works, quality, site safety and warranty.
scope.r3: The plan does not include a full-time engineer on site.

calm.check: An engineer checks at key milestones

quality.control: Shell and actual materials both controlled

notes.scope: Priced per project for homes up to 3 storeys and 300 m² of floor area; beyond that, add-ons apply.
notes.area: Standard service area is within 30 km of an engineer base; travel costs apply beyond that.

dashboard.title: Supervision dashboard
dashboard.lead: Six fixed stages from legal paperwork to acceptance and handover. Uploading named photos or documents completes a stage and moves the progress thread on; the supervisor then inspects on site and confirms. Confirmed records only change when both sides agree.

banner.body: Stage {index} – {stage}: due {due}. Upload named photos or documents to complete the stage.
banner.overdueBody: Stage {index} – {stage} passed its due date of {due}. Upload the records or contact support to reschedule.

schedule.title: Six-stage schedule
schedule.note: Standard schedule is {days} days from activation. The supervisor adjusts it to reality and you are notified when it changes.

stage.heading: Stage {index} of 6
stage.upcomingBody: Starts {date} (in {days} days), once stage {previous} is complete.
stage.lockedNotice: The supervisor inspected on site and confirmed on {date} — records are locked at {version}. To add photos or correct a comment, send a change request for the supervisor to approve.
stage.filesLocked: Locked at {version} — changes need a change request
stage.commentsLocked: Locked — adding or correcting comments needs a change request
stage.commentPlaceholder: Discuss this stage with the supervisor (the engineer is notified)...
stage.commentSent: Your comment was sent to the supervisor.
stage.inspectionEmptyBody: Once the stage is complete, the supervisor inspects on site, records findings and confirms.
stage.historyNote: History is never deleted; every change records who, which role, when and the version.
stage.uploadHint: Upload named photos or documents to mark this stage complete. The supervisor inspects on site and confirms afterwards.

upload.title: Upload records · Stage {index} – {stage}
upload.lead: Uploading completes the stage — the supervisor inspects and confirms afterwards. Uploaded by {user} · capture time (EXIF) and upload time are stored.
upload.dropzone: Drag and drop or choose files · up to 10 MB each
upload.name: Name / note

upload.needFile: Choose at least one file before completing the stage.
upload.needName: Name the upload so the supervisor knows what it is.
upload.done: Records uploaded. Stage {index} now awaits the supervisor check.

change.bannerTitle: The supervisor proposed a change to confirmed records ({code})
change.bannerBody: Please review before {due}. Records only change if you agree; decline and {version} stands.
change.approved: Change request approved. Stage records moved to {version}.
change.rejected: Change request declined. Records stay at {version}.
change.createBody: Describe what you want added or corrected. The supervisor approves before records move to a new version.
change.createPlaceholder: e.g. Add photos of column starter bars after formwork removal so the stage record is complete.
change.sent: Your change request was sent to the supervisor.
